name: Kaidou Nagiko
source:
Hobbies: Marine sports and Aikidos.
Favorite foods: Yakisoba Bread and stew.

"What? You sure have quite a rude attitude towards the very kind upperclassman who caught you."

She is a 3rd year at Kazami Academy and a part of the Active Club.

With an easy-going personality, she has an older sister disposition who cares for others. There are tons of people in her surroundings that rely on her.

She's shy and has a low tolerance when it comes to guys, which ends up having her take a cold attitude towards them by mistake, and got disheartened with self-hatred as she tells herself that she is inexperienced.

She is Hibiki's cousin. She wanted to be around Hibiki who like her cute little sister, so she decided to join the Active Club.

She seems capable in every sport and has been doing marine sports and aikido since she was a child.

[Translated from [url=http://sagaplanets.product.co.jp/works/kakenuke/index.html]Official Website[/url]]
